feature: M2 first cut: bounded Git replay and advisory planning
conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and feature author. Codex prepared the bounded review and recorded the founder's explicit decision. This is internal founder review, not independent validation.

boundedReview.rationale: Approve the bounded first cut and accept ADR 0013 for exhaustive replay of fixed commit patches under tracked-tree-v1 and consultative planning only. The decision does not claim semantic correctness, production safety, arbitrary concurrent safety or execution authorization.

adr0013.rationale: Accept the isolated Git replay and advisory planning boundary in ADR 0013 as reviewed at the frozen candidate commit.

m2Closure.rationale: This decision approves only the first cut. M2 remains open for deeper risk hardening and stronger, evidence-backed parallel-integration capabilities.

postCutFollowUps: T009: replace process-global environment mutation and add concurrent-caller coverage.
T010: enforce end-to-end resource budgets and distinguish infrastructure failures from patch rejection.
T011: validate or regenerate plan artifacts and enforce semantic consistency with verified evidence.
T012: define and review the execution contract required for safe parallel integration.
T013: implement and evaluate a gated parallel-integration prototype after T012 review.
limits: Approval applies to the frozen candidate commit and the bounded first-cut claim only.
M2 remains open; no concurrent integration, project-code execution, publication or use of planner results to mutate the repository is authorized.
Tracked-tree equivalence for fixed patches does not establish source correctness, semantic independence, arbitrary interleaving safety, general confluence or production safety.
Recorded follow-ups for thread safety, end-to-end resource limits, plan integrity and parallel integration remain incomplete.
Review is founder-led and internal; independent validation remains pending.
